units.source_text: 此时正是十月底，故诗中如此说。

en.t: It was just the end of the tenth month at this time, and that is why the poem speaks as it does.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想起不到宇治已有一个多月了，心甚焦灼。

en.t: Prince Niou remembered that more than a month had passed since he had gone to Uji, and his heart was deeply restless.

units.source_text: 他夜夜想走，而故障甚多。

en.t: Night after night he wanted to set out, but there were many obstacles in his way.

units.source_text: 今年的五节舞会来得很早，宫中喧哗扰攘，甚是纷忙。

en.t: This year the Gosechi dance ceremonies came early, and the palace was noisy, crowded, and extremely busy.

units.source_text: 匂亲王并非有意不去，但终于未能走访，遥想山庄中人望穿秋水了。

en.t: Prince Niou was not deliberately staying away, but in the end he could not visit, and he imagined the people at the mountain villa waiting for him with longing eyes.

units.source_text: 他在宫中虽然有时和侍女们调笑，但时时刻刻不忘二女公子。

en.t: Although he sometimes joked and flirted with the ladies in waiting at the palace, he never forgot the Second Princess for even a moment.

units.source_text: 关于左大臣家的亲事，明石皇后对他说道：“你终当有个名正言顺的妻室。

en.t: Regarding the marriage proposal from the Left Minister's family, Empress Akashi said to him, "In the end you must have a proper and legitimate wife.

units.source_text: 此外你倘有欲得之人，也不妨迎娶入宫，定当予以优遇。”

en.t: Besides that, if there is someone else you desire, you may bring her into the palace as well, and I will certainly treat her with favor."

units.source_text: 匂亲王拒绝：“请暂缓，尚须考虑。”

en.t: Prince Niou refused, saying, "Please put this off for a while; I still need to think it over."

units.source_text: 因为他真心欲使二女公子不遭苦厄。

en.t: For he sincerely wished to keep the Second Princess from suffering hardship.

units.source_text: 但山庄中人不知道他这一片诚心，只是随着日月而增加悲伤。

en.t: But the people at the mountain villa did not know this sincere feeling of his, and their sorrow only deepened as the days and months passed.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言也觉得匂亲王的轻薄出乎意外。

en.t: Counselor Kaoru, too, found Prince Niou's fickleness unexpected.

units.source_text: 他万万想不到如此演变，真心地为二女公子惋惜。

en.t: He had never imagined that matters would turn out this way, and he sincerely pitied the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 他几乎绝不去访晤匂亲王了。

en.t: He almost never went to visit Prince Niou anymore.

units.source_text: 但他关怀山庄中的女公子，屡次前往探访。

en.t: But he cared about the princess at the mountain villa, and went there repeatedly to call on her.
